proposal.reason: Trial 1 used word features with C=0.3 and achieved high accuracy but very low spam recall, leaving macro_f1 at 0.484. A char n-gram representation may capture spam-specific character patterns and obfuscations that word tokens miss; C=3.0 tests whether less regularization helps the minority class signal.
proposal.review: Primary trial 1 is completed: single_word_C0.3, macro_f1 0.4843, accuracy 0.8727, spam recall 0.0187. The fitted estimator was logistic, but no classifier was declared in the trial configuration. This candidate is a new primary-search configuration, not a confirmation-split comparison.
proposal.hypothesis: Char n-gram features with C=3.0 will represent spam-specific character patterns better than the word-only C=0.3 baseline and may improve spam recall enough to raise macro_f1.
proposal.uncertainty: Unknown whether char features and C=3.0 will improve macro_f1 or overfit; the prior trial shows only that word C=0.3 had near-zero spam recall. No formal test is available, and this is a single primary-search proposal.
